description:
From the 2026-07 remediation batch (#1176 w0 discovery): the tuning config
never reached adapters on the direct CLI path. #1176 fixed the channel and
duckdb; a parallel fix covered questdb. Roughly 48 other platforms'
from_config implementations still drop tuning_enabled / the tuning_config
object / tuning_source / tuning_source_file, so tuning silently no-ops on
them via the direct path. Sweep every from_config to forward the tuning
keys, and add a parametrized registry-driven test asserting every registered
adapter preserves them (constructing with stub configs, no live connections).

preserves.behavior: Each adapter's existing from_config behavior for its own keys
No new required constructor params - forwarding only

verifications.command: uv run -- python -m pytest tests/unit/platforms -q -k 'from_config or forwarding'
verifications.description: Registry-driven forwarding test green across all platforms
verifications.expected: All registered adapters preserve tuning kwargs

work_units.summary: Start gate: verify PR #1176 merged; enumerate from_config implementations and classify forwarding status
Mechanical sweep: forward tuning keys in every from_config (follow the duckdb/questdb pattern)

work_units.notes: Skip-gate platforms whose import needs missing optional deps, matching existing registry-test conventions.
work_units.summary: Parametrized test over the platform registry: from_config preserves tuning kwargs for every adapter
